episode_summary: In this episode, Kim Rittberg emphasizes the power of short form video and AI tools in enhancing real estate agents' online presence and efficiency. She provides actionable insights on creating engaging video content and leveraging AI for content planning and editing. The discussion highlights the importance of personal branding and staying top of mind with clients through consistent video engagement.
